text:
maria: NewClient says onboarding finished but their API calls are 403. Console shows an API key was created though. key_id: key_01G7X9Z. Anyone seen this mapping/provisioner glitch recently?
ashish: Can you paste org/project IDs and the exact key id so I can check provisioner logs?
maria: org_id: org-8342, project_id: newclient-prod, key_id: key_01G7X9Z
maria: curl output: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer key_01G7X9Z" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "permission_denied", "code": 403 }
```
deploy-bot: provisioning-service: created key key_01G7X9Z at 2026-03-17T12:42:10Z -> bound_project: redwood-internal-ops-123
jordan: ah — looks like the provisioner routed it into an internal/shadow project (redwood-internal-ops-123). we've seen a race where org claims are applied late and the mapper falls back to the ops bucket. i'll pull mapper logs for that time window.
ashish: For remediation we can rebind the key to the correct project. Use the admin tool: ```
ri admin rebind-key --key key_01G7X9Z --to-project newclient-prod
```
jordan: i approve the rebind. i'll also add a short guard in mapper to avoid falling back when the claim is pending.
maria: running the rebind now... -> returned 200, key re-bound to newclient-prod
maria: quick smoke after rebind: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer key_01G7X9Z" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "models": [ ... ] }
```
maria: customer confirms calls succeed from their side :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ticket INC-21987 created by ashish.automation -> action: rebind key; ticket auto-closed after verification
ashish: i'll open a short postmortem and assign to eng-provisioner to harden the mapper logic. tagging @jordan for the follow-up. closing support case with the customer.

(attachments: console-screenshot-url: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/3799123456/console_key_shot.png)
